issue.title: Conversation titles and About summaries describe only the latest request, not what's still in context
acceptanceCriteria: Parser test: a synthetic Claude Code JSONL with early turns, a `compact_boundary`, an `isCompactSummary` user record, and later turns. `latestCompactSummary.text` is the full summary, and `messages` still does not contain it. An incremental parse that appends a second summary replaces the first. An incremental parse with no new summary keeps the first.

`src/lib/conversations/__tests__/transcript-summary.test.ts`: with a compaction summary longer than 1,800 chars plus later turns, the serialized About transcript and the title window both contain the summary's "Primary Request and Intent" text. They contain the turns after the summary and none of the turns before it. With no summary, the output is byte-identical to today's.

`tests/unit/lib/overdeck/title-refinement.test.ts`: with an injected `getCachedMessages` returning a summary and later turns, the transcript passed to `summarizeTranscriptTitle` includes the summary text. This proves the summary reaches the model prompt.
The title prompt no longer contains "favor the most recent direction". It asks for the overall scope still in context.
`fallbackTranscriptTitle` derives from the summary's primary request when a summary is present.
Existing tests in these files stay green. `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass.
Manual check: re-running retitle and About on conversation 2878 gives a title and summary that cover the orchestration work, not only the intro video.
